_comment: **Shipped as a placed feature rather than built in code**, unlike the rime crystals, and that is what
makes it writable: `Features.PLACES` resolves by `ResourceKey` out of the registry, so only a feature
with an id can be named in a sentence, weighed by a rung, or matched by the D'ni city looking for its
third criterion. A direct holder would be invisible to all three.
Scattered up the whole column because the water it wants may be anywhere -- a cavern lake, a flooded
hall, an overhung pool. Each attempt falls until it finds a surface or runs out, so the tries that
start in rock cost a short walk and nothing else.
**The count is a weak dial and the numbers say how weak.** One patch covers 169 columns and a chunk
has 256, so at any count worth having the patches overlap about tenfold and most seeds land on water
that already has a mat. Measured over the same 49 chunks of a colossal vault: 24 sows 29450, 15 sows
26390, 8 sows 20869 -- a two-thirds cut in the count for a third off the lake.
Sown thinner because at 24 the lake arrived at the density the spread declines at, so nothing ever
visibly grew and the mottling the mushroom rule exists to make was invisible (Jonah, walked
2026-09-08). If it wants thinning again, this is still the dial -- just not a proportional one.
